question:
Which of the following pair is correctly matched in context of person and related to their musical instrument ?

I. Totaram Sharma - Pakhawaj

II. Zakir Hussain - Flute
solution:
The correct answer is__** Only I**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Totaram Sharma - Pakhawaj**:

 
 
• This is correct.
 
 
• **Totaram Sharma was a renowned Indian classical musician and a master of the *Pakhawaj*, a traditional drum often used in classical music and dance performances.**
 
 
 
 
 
• **II. Zakir Hussain - Flute**:
 
 
• This is incorrect.
 
 
• **Zakir Hussain is a legendary tabla virtuoso, not a flutist**.
 
 
• He is internationally renowned for his mastery of the *tabla*, not the *flute*.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct pair is **Totaram Sharma - Pakhawaj**, While Zakir Hussain is associated with the tabla, not the flute.
